User Story: As a user I want to log in via company SSO so that I don't need a separate password
As an admin I want to assign role tiers so that access matches responsibility
As an admin I want to deactivate a user while preserving their activity history
As a sales rep I want to create and edit contact records so that I can track my customers
As a sales rep I want duplicate-detection on save so that I don't create redundant records
As a sales rep I want to group contacts under an Account so that I can see all stakeholders at a company
As a sales rep I want a full activity timeline per contact so that I have context before a call
As an admin I want CSV bulk import with field mapping so that I can onboard new contact lists
As a sales rep I want a kanban pipeline view so that I can see all deals by stage
As a sales rep I want drag-and-drop stage changes with no page reload so that updating a deal is fast
As a sales manager I want deal value roll-ups per stage and per rep so that I can gauge pipeline health
As a sales rep I want to capture a won/lost reason on close so that we can analyze patterns later
As DevOps I want role-based access enforced at the API layer so that permissions can't be bypassed via direct calls
As an admin I want a full audit log of record access and changes so that we meet compliance requirements
As a leader I want a live pipeline dashboard so that I don't need a manual monthly report
As a leader I want to export reports as CSV/PDF so that I can share them outside the tool
As a sales manager I want rep-level and team-level performance views so that I can run 1:1s with data
As a sales rep I want two-way email sync logged to the contact timeline so that I don't switch tools
As an admin I want a Zapier integration with at least 3 triggers so that we can automate CS workflows
As an admin I want a guided migration tool from the legacy database so that we don't lose historical data
As an admin I want a dry-run migration report before committing so that I can catch issues safely
As a Data Privacy Officer I want a right-to-erasure workflow so that we meet GDPR obligations
As DevOps I want daily automated backups with a tested restore procedure so that we can recover from failure
As a customer I want a self-service portal so that I can manage my own account (post-MVP, out of scope)
As a user I want a native mobile app so that I can work from my phone (post-MVP, out of scope)
